Title: General availability: Azure API Management updates - July 2021

Body.Content:
We started a regular Azure API Management service update on July 5, 2021. It includes the following new features, bug fixes, and other improvements.

New

  • You can now emit custom metrics to Azure Application Insights with the new emit-metric policy.
  • Policy expressions now support System.Net.IPAddress.
  • The policy expressions' context object now includes the context.Deployment.GatewayId property. For managed gateways, its value is managed.
  • You can now export your APIs for consumption in the Power Platform through the dedicated Power Platform page in the Azure portal.

Details on all these new features, bug fixes, and other changes can be found here on Github.
